in_sanskrit.name: Jinal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victory, Triumph
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jinal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jinal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jina' meaning 'victor'. It is a name of respect and admiration, often given to those who have achieved great success or overcome significant challenges. In Hindu mythology, the Jinas are a group of enlightened beings who have conquered their passions and desires, attaining spiritual liberation.
